acquisition.capture: <run>/reading (states_reading.py on the candidate's tokens), then <run>/correspondence.json (states_conditional.py), then <run>/check.json (states_conditional_check.py)

hypothesis: The project's hypothesis: a capability leaves a recurring difference between the traces of correct and wrong answers, and editing the weights where that recurring difference lives repairs the capability. The affine sweep tested it on the model's own answers, where two things changed at once: the weights and the text the model writes. This run supplies the reading that separates them and tests one thing of its own, about the instrument: that the original's weights can be read on the candidate's text by the same reader under the same execution as the original control and the candidate, so that with the mapping, the reference and the target held fixed L(W1,H1) - L(W0,H0) = [L(W0,H1) - L(W0,H0)] + [L(W1,H1) - L(W0,H1)], the first bracket being what the changed text alone does under the original's weights and the second what the changed weights do on that text.
why_this_direction: Step 5 judges an edit by the computation discrepancy over the whole original-registered trace on the edited model's own answers. Both whole-gap comparisons are finished and assessed (the affine one: 0.069466 to 0.127162 in all (the wrong members 0.069466 to 0.075842, the correct members 1.04e-14 to 0.051320)), and Astra's assessment could not say how much of either group's change is the weights and how much the reworded history read through the mapping: all thirty texts changed in both candidates. The records already hold that the difference matters: a2-path's own-answer plus rode on its wording (the original's weights favour the plus at 5 of 6 rows on a2-path's text), a rise of the own-trace L has been the wording three times of three, and at the sign's row of this cohort the matched-context model's plus is the weights' at 12 of 15 wrong answers and the wording's at 10 of 15. Those are single rows or single sums. Astra's next target decision (an original-state variant, a row assignment) needs the split at every row and every merge, and the one reading that gives it is the original's weights on the candidate's own text. It is the next step because both candidates are frozen, their captures and mappings exist, card 0 is free of this repository's jobs, and nothing else Astra asked of this seat can be scored without it.
repeating_pattern_check: Four things have happened more than once. (1) An own-answer result was read as the weights' when part of it was the text's: a2-path's sign count, the own-trace L's rises, and this evening's sign row. This run reads the text's part directly at every row, with the weights held at the original's. (2) Two readings were compared that were not made the same way (the two cards word 9 of 30 answers differently; a text read 32 tokens at once is another computation; a reading without its libraries' hash is not found). Here the reader, recorder, engine, card and driver are the protocol's, the record refuses anything else, and the check counts by bytes that this reading and the original control agree wherever they were given one input. (3) A contract was stretched to let a new kind of reading through, or a check rested on shape instead of content (the file-time shortcut of November 14; a capture's pairs bound after the fact). The primary scorer refuses a reading whose text is not the reading model's own, and that refusal stays: the control has another format name, and its mapping is not laid again but taken from the candidate's own record and held to it by sha256 and by value. (4) A capture stopped on the disk's margin mid-way. The reader refuses to start unless what it may hold at once leaves the 40 GiB margin, and this seat reads the free space before each of the two readings.
what_went_wrong_before: Each whole-gap comparison read the candidate on its own text against the original on its own text, and its two sums cannot be told apart into text and weights. The one reading that held the weights fixed on a changed text was made at one row (the sign's), for one candidate, with eight scores a step and no states. Before that, every control of a candidate's own-path reading was a count of signs or a single sum of L, and three constructions were assessed without knowing which part of their own-trace movement the wording was.
rule: Data roles: the thirty fitting answers of the cohort (tube.picks) and no others. The answers no fit uses are not read, the reserved folder is not opened, and no answer is generated: each answer's prompt is read as every pass reads it, then the candidate's own tokens are supplied one at a time, and every decision's scores say whether the supplied token is the original's own first choice; where it is not, that is recorded and the feed is not changed. One recorder process on card 0 under the card's lock (after-the-others.sh), the installed recorder and engine, fusion disabled as in every pass. Before a row is kept the engine's ADD is made again from the two operands the same pass recorded and must give the kept row bit for bit; a row that does not is an error and the reading stops. Nothing is derived, normalized or rounded in what is kept. The record lays no pair: it takes the candidate's own mapping from the candidate's capture and primary record and refuses where the two differ. The check invents no tolerance: it counts rows that are the same bits. The reading is conditional and is named so everywhere: it is not the original's own answer, it is no success count, and the candidate's primary result stands as it was scored. Everything is written inside this run's folder. Nothing here makes a target, selects, scores, fits or writes a model.
prediction: Counted by the three commands. (1) The reading is whole: 30 answers and 21,443 rows a merge (16,284 answer steps of the candidate's text and 5,159 question positions) at each of the 105 merges, the ADD made again at every one of them. (2) In 30 of 30 answers the first supplied token that is not the original's own first choice is the first token of the candidate's text that is not the recording's (steps 3 to 83, 59 at the median, counted from the two token lists before any pass), so no answer is the original's own whole text and all thirty are conditional. (3) At the rows computed from one input in both readings, the 5,159 question rows and the 1,455 answer rows up to and at that step, 6,614 rows, this reading holds the bits whole-states-original/reading holds, at all 105 merges and in both terminal arrays. (4) The conditional record is written through the candidate's own mapping: 30 answers changed and none unchanged, every pair, text and original computation the one the candidate's primary record holds. No loss is predicted: the conditional score is the scorer's. This seat holds no reading of the original's weights on this candidate's text and states no expectation of that score: 10 of its 30 answers run to the length limit, and how the original's states on those texts stand against the field is not known from any record.
would_weaken_it: (1) A row the ADD does not reproduce would mean the stream's records of a merge are not one engine operation: nothing kept is used. (2) A first departure anywhere else than where the candidate's text leaves the recording would mean the recordings are not the original's own answers under this recorder, engine and card, which every reading of this cohort assumes; the table says which answer and step. (3) A row given one input that is not the same bits as the original control's would mean the two terms of the split are not one model on one execution: a difference of execution would then sit inside the term read as the text's, and the split is not usable as it stands. The check says at which merges and how many rows, and Astra is told what was found; no tolerance is set to pass it. (4) A refusal of the record would mean the candidate's capture and its primary record do not hold one mapping, which would put the candidate's own comparison in question before this one. Nothing here can weaken or strengthen the research hypothesis by itself: that is read from the score Astra makes of this reading beside the candidate's and the original's.

answers.scales_with: the cohort's answers and their outcome labels

rows.derivation: over the fitting answers, the sum of the steps of the candidate's own answers as its capture holds them (16,284) and of their question positions (5,159): 21,443 rows a merge, ordered all answers' answer rows then all answers' question rows, the order of the candidate's own reading
rows.scales_with: the lengths of the candidate's own answers and the cohort's prompts

merges.derivation: three merges a layer (the attention's, the feed-forward's, the per-layer embedding's) over the 35 layers the index lists: 105, numbered 3L, 3L+1, 3L+2
merges.scales_with: the model's layers and the merges the engine makes in each

rows_given_one_input.derivation: for each fitting answer, the first step at which the candidate's own tokens are not the cohort's recorded tokens (d), counted from the two token lists; the rows 0 to d of each answer (1,455 together) and every question row (5,159): 6,614 rows. Row d is computed from the recording's tokens alone; every later row has the candidate's token in its input and is not compared.
rows_given_one_input.scales_with: where each of the candidate's answers leaves the recording, and the prompts' lengths

room.derivation: the reader starts only if free space less what it may hold at once leaves fed_replay.MARGIN_GIB (40 GiB, the machine's disk rule): the arrays, (21,443 x 106 + 16,284) x 1,536 x 4 bytes (13.10 GiB), and the raw streams of KEEPERS + 2 answers at the longest answer's size, positions x 247 recorded outputs x 1,536 x 4 bytes: 21.1 GiB at most
room.scales_with: rows, merges, the state's width, the longest answer and the number of keepers

keepers.derivation: four keeping processes on processor threads 4, 5, 12 and 13, beside the recorder's own, as the original control was read ('The engine's own state at every merge and every row'); they change when an answer's rows are kept, never what is kept
keepers.scales_with: the processor threads left free by the other seats' jobs
